invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of 'scheduleLogCompactionExecutor.execute()', which by convention for Option<T> is expected to be non-null.
Compaction and scheduling require a valid non-empty instant time identifier.
Option parameters are typically never null, per idiomatic usage.
The engine context is required for compaction operations and should not be null.
For Option<T>, isPresent() status partitions all possible states. This serves as a completeness check.
